text:
anna: Heads up — we're starting a staged deprecation of the old header `X-Route-Policy` in favor of `X-RD-Route` to unify routing metadata across hosted/dedicated/private. Plan = 6-week opt-in -> 4-week shim -> remove. Posting details and SDK impact here.
sam_devex: Quick q — is this purely a renaming or semantics change? any behavior changes in routing?
anna: Mostly rename + tightening on allowed keys (we'll only accept `route`, `priority`, and `tenant`). Existing freeform kv pairs will be dropped in 2nd phase. No change to routing logic otherwise.
lee: For SDKs, this implies header renaming in request wrapper. Python/TS/Go clients will need a minor bump. We should avoid surprising regen of bytes for embeddings teams.
maria: Telemetry note: console dashboards rely on the old header for attribution -> need mapping in ingestion so existing dashboards don't regress during canary. I can add a server-side map for the rollout window.
john_r: Quota attribution relies on `route` value. If freeform kvs are dropped, any tenant-derived attribution that parsed custom fields could break. We should publish a migration guide for customers that parse route metadata.
sam_devex: Implementation idea: SDKs add `rd_route` high-level param and continue to synthesize `X-Route-Policy` until shim removal. That buys us time for console + metrics mapping.
anna: Exactly. Proposed timeline: week1 announce & opt-in flag in console; week2 SDK patch releases with compatibility mode default=true; week4 enable shim server-side mapping; week6 flip default=false and start rejecting unknown keys; week10 hard remove header. Thoughts?
lee: Sounds reasonable. For release notes: Python -> 1.12.0, TS -> 0.42.0, Go -> v0.9.0. Will include code snippets showing `client.request({ rd_route: { route: 'nlp-prod', priority: 'low' } })` -> header generation.
maria: I'll add a console tile that surfaces apps still sending legacy header so SEs can contact customers.
john_r: How about telemetry sampling? We should tag any request that used legacy header with `legacy_route=true` so we can measure adoption before flipping.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary on infra-2 at 2026-04-02T03:00Z, full region A on 2026-04-05T03:00Z.
anna: Good call on tagging. Also add migration note: customers using traffic-splitting by route key must update their rules to reference `route` top-level field. We'll draft a short migration checklist.
sam_devex: One gotcha: proxies that canonicalize header casing might produce `x-route-policy` which our shim may miss. Let's doc that and normalize server-side.
lee: I'll ensure SDK header generator uses exact casing `X-RD-Route` and also adds the legacy header when compat=true. Patch PRs incoming: python #789, ts #1450, go #332.
maria: I'll coordinate dashboard mapping + create a fast alert if legacy proportion > 30% after week4.
john_r: For privacy/compliance, ensure we don't widen what is sent — the allowed keys list is important. Add a KMS audit note for private deployments.
anna: Thanks all — next actions: lee/sam to cut SDK PRs by EOD Fri, maria to add ingest map and dashboard, ops-bot to confirm the deploy windows, I'll draft the public migration doc and send to SRE/Support. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started on infra-2. Logs: `deploy 1769876601 started by ops-bot`
anna: Leaving this thread open for updates, please post PR links and any rollback ideas here.
